attribution_limitations: PC-in-ELF is static code-range evidence, not complete process attribution.
Runtime load-base, PIE/ASLR, and exact board runtime ELF must be accounted for before strong process ownership claims.
Target/process ownership still requires marker scope, PID/SATP/ASID, or runtime load-map evidence.
notes: This is local ELF/code attribution metadata for synthetic behavior audit triage.
It does not prove process ownership without target-scoped trace or OS context evidence.
For board traces, use a code map generated from the exact board runtime ELF when available.
ELF type EXEC; load-base assumption: fixed_vaddr_exec.

limitations: Function-level attribution from symbols is not source-line attribution.
Source-line attribution requires retained DWARF/debug-line metadata or an addr2line-compatible side channel.
source_attribution.source_line_basis: DWARF/source-line decoding is not present in rvmt.code_map.v1
